maddeler.e:
استشهدتن (form X)
# اِسْتَشْهَدْتُنَّ (istašhadtunna) /is.taʃ.had.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# اُسْتُشْهِدْتُنَّ (ustušhidtunna) /us.tuʃ.hid.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
